name: North Goods Co.
headline: Things made to outlast you.
subhead: A small shop of tools, textiles and kitchen goods chosen for how they wear in, not how they photograph.

services.name: Tools & hardware
services.text: Hand tools from makers still forging their own steel.

services.name: Home & kitchen
services.text: Cast iron, linen and enamelware built for daily use.

services.name: Textiles
services.text: Blankets and aprons woven in small runs, mostly within the state.

services.name: Gifts
services.text: We'll help you find something and wrap it while you wait.

aboutText: We buy from people we've met. Everything in the shop has been used by one of us long enough to know how it holds up after a year, and we'll tell you honestly when the cheaper option is the better one.
